skill.summary: Extract text from images, documents and scanned PDFs using OpenOCR - a lightweight and efficient OCR system with document parsing model requiring only 0.1B parameters, capable of running recognition on personal PCs. Supports text detection, recognition, universal VLM recognition, and document parsing with layout analysis
